scope: Local PostgreSQL / PGlite; real migrations, allow and deny tests; no production work records

checks.name: employee-code login returns expiring sessions and unknown employees get registration
bare API cannot read jobs or use the old code-only login RPC
registration is pending and cannot grant its requested engineer role
manager sees plans but cannot mutate repairs, plans or impersonate engineer
production cannot approve as manager and manager waits for production
engineer can confirm production and approve with recorded actor
engineer appears in assignees and can inspect and work across departments
assigned technician can start TPM, cannot edit plan fields, and cannot approve
started plan cannot be approved or returned even by engineer
engineer approves pending registration once and cannot remove last engineer
disabled user loses existing session immediately
private photo policies deny signed-out and manager upload, permit maintainer
logout invalidates the old token; expiry and invalid tokens fail closed
